findingDetails.title: Phase 4 implementation summary still declares closure blocked after AC-002 closed
findingDetails.case: An operator resumes Phase 4, reads implementation-summary.md front to back, and treats "AC-002 remains Unmet" as live status, re-running T006 or blocking parent closure.
findingDetails.evidence: Summary body says AC-002 remains Unmet while acceptance-criteria.md:61 marks it Met against build-evidence.md:152 (exit=0, 12 passed), spec.md:23 says Complete, and the summary frontmatter says completion_pct 100.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All four citations are inside the declared target; contradictory sentences and the captured exit are quoted from the reviewed files.

findingDetails.title: Parent phase map marks every implementation phase Pending while four children report closed
findingDetails.case: An operator resumes the track from the parent map, is sent to a closed phase, and cannot tell from that map that only Phase 5 is open.
findingDetails.evidence: Rows 2-6 read Pending (133-137) and prose at 142/183 repeats it, while 002/003/004 report completion_pct 100 and 006 reports 96 with all five AC rows Met; only 005 at 75 percent Draft matches its row. Line 143 still routes resume to closed Phase 2.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Parent rows and child status fields both quoted from the target; no inference beyond numeric field values.
affectedSurfaceHints: resource:/speckit:resume entry path at parent spec.md:143
reference:parent phase map as aggregate progress view

findingDetails.title: One-lineage refusal and its opt-in are absent from every capability surface documenting the runner
findingDetails.case: An operator hand-builds a one-entry executor config, hits the fan-out refusal, and finds no documented route back to the single-executor workflow or to --allow-single-lineage.
findingDetails.evidence: Catalog enumerates only the routing rule; a search for allow-single-lineage, "expands to one lineage" and "one lineage" across review.md, research.md, both presentation assets and the catalog returns routing-sentence hits only, never the refusal or opt-in that exist at fanout-run.cjs:3400-3407 and are tested at fanout-run.vitest.ts:2536-2543.
findingDetails.scopeProof: A whole-set negative search over the four named surfaces plus the catalog, not a single-file read; guard lines quoted from the runner.

findingDetails.title: Phase 6 marks all five criteria Met while its summary records an unresolved P1 checklist conflict
findingDetails.case: A closure check reads only acceptance-criteria.md, sees five Met rows, and closes Phase 6 while the unresolved CHK-012 conflict travels into the parent packet.
findingDetails.evidence: Summary states the packet remains Draft because CHK-012 is an unresolved P1 item, with next_safe_action at line 14 and an open question at line 24, while acceptance-criteria.md:64-68 marks AC-001..AC-005 Met and build-evidence.md:145 shows the diff is scoped to the plan_clarity row.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both sides quoted from within the target; corroborating diff note quoted from the target scratch evidence.
affectedSurfaceHints: resource:006-to-parent handoff criterion at parent spec.md:155
